name: update-notice
title: Update Notice
description: A prompt that tells people a new version of your app is deployed and reloads them onto it.
docs: Add `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME ??= new Date().toISOString()` to the top of next.config.ts, then mount <UpdateNotice /> once in your root layout. Serve /app-version.json with Cache-Control: no-store.
